summary.headline: Nature of the Seven Planets
summary.text: Discussion of the nature of the seven planets, attributed to Ptolemy, including their hot, cold, dry, and moist qualities and the disputed authorship of the Tetrabiblos. The text also gives astronomical objections concerning the Moon and begins a list of planetary exaltations and depressions, including the Sun, Saturn, Libra, Moon, Taurus, and Scorpio.
